proposals.name: REVERT_ROLLBACK
proposals.definition: A save whose summary or effect is an explicit restoration of a prior revision ('revert to revision X.Y') or removal of another editor's recent additions to restore an earlier state, as opposed to overwriting with new authored content.
proposals.rationale: Several units are reverts/rollbacks (ZZZEnrollmentAsianFeb21Help@4 'revert to revision 1.2'; OECDEducationEquitySequence@16 'revert to revision 1.6'). These are distinct from E1 OVERWRITE_OTHER (new content replaces old) and E4 REMOVE (pure deletion) because they restore a named prior state. Currently miscoded as E4 or E1.

proposals.name: ID_CHURN_RESAVE
proposals.definition: An overwrite/modify whose only substantive change is incrementing or swapping an embedded identifier/counter token (e.g. OV57714749->OV82669689, STABLE 166->174, uniq/float numbers) while heading and body stay otherwise identical.
proposals.rationale: A recurring form on hub and own pages (OurCountyPrettyAgentXYZ@7, WillkommenImWiki@296, WillkommenImWiki@33, AgentOwnSec88221@15, PokeUniqueWord@5 chains) where the edit is pure token-cycling cache-busting, not new content. B3 WRITE_MARKER covers a marker inside a substantive save but not a save that IS only marker-cycling.

proposals.name: CAPACITY_PROBE
proposals.definition: Content that tests storage/length limits rather than save-success or markup, e.g. a long run of a single repeated character, or deliberately oversized filler.
proposals.rationale: NewPageX010@5 (hundreds of 'a's) fits neither C1 (test/hello appends) nor C2 (markup/script rendering). It probes buffer/size behavior.

proposals.name: Viewer/inspector services split
proposals.definition: Distinguish fetch/convert proxies (r.jina.ai, markdown.new, allorigins) from interactive JSON/data VIEWER services (jsonhero.io, drive viewerng, docs.google gview) that present but do not proxy-fetch for programmatic retrieval.
proposals.rationale: jsonhero.io links recur heavily in probier units and are ambiguous between A1 (direct source) and A2 (routed service). They are neither: they are human-facing inspectors of an already-uploaded blob. Coders will disagree. A1/A2 boundary needs a third category or explicit rule.

proposals.name: FORMAT_VARIANT_EDIT
proposals.definition: A modify that substitutes the output format/endpoint of an existing source link (e.g. jsonrecords->data.csv, mode/max_tokens change, encoding scheme change) without adding a new target.
proposals.rationale: EN~2fPumsApiLa927@5 (jsonrecords->csv) and several md.succ fit/max_tokens swaps are edits refining retrieval format. Not a sweep (A3, which needs >=4), not clearly D14 method-share. A sub-act or modifier would capture the common 'tune the retrieval' behavior.

proposals.name: WRITE_PROBE summary-vs-body
proposals.definition: Clarify that C1 applies when the VISIBLE SAVED CONTENT is a test, not when only the edit summary says 'test' while the body is substantive data.
proposals.rationale: Many substantive data/overwrite saves carry summaries like 'test8610791185277308', 'colltest', 'GET save test', 'test one'. Coding C1 off the summary conflates genuine probes with labeled production edits. The header summary is Layer-0 mechanics; a rule is needed on whether summary text counts.

proposals.name: PAGE_SIZE_HYGIENE
proposals.definition: Sharpen that 'preserve page short (<4KB)', 'if page grows/locks post elsewhere', and compaction-to-keep-GET-working are a recurring constraint-driven maintenance act combining D17 (size limit) + B4 (relocation) + a compaction sub-act.
proposals.rationale: Sector61State5FastSignal@55, DataUSAGrocerySequenceCollab2027@20, FinanceSequenceMar26OAI@31 all show deliberate page-size management. The 'compact older chatter' deletion is neither E4 nor plain B4; it's hygiene. Worth an explicit code.

proposals.name: Relay-request vs recruit boundary
proposals.definition: Clarify D7 (asks unspecified peers to post info about the SAME task) vs D20 (invites agents, possibly on a DIFFERENT task, to a named place). Several units blur these.
proposals.rationale: AgentOAINYConstructionBridge@2 invites 'matching timed-task agents' to a named page—looks like D20 but is same-task relay, so D7 overlaps. The 'same task?' test is hard to apply from one unit.

result.general_observations: The batch is dominated by two populations: (1) competitive hub-page churn on WillkommenImWiki/StartSeite where agents repeatedly overwrite each other with near-identical SEC/county link blocks, self-nav chains, and cycling ID tokens—E1 fires constantly but the interesting signal (who-copies-whom, ID-cycling, mine-vs-yours naming) is cross-unit and token-level; and (2) timed-task coordination on dse sequence pages, where D-codes apply densely and generally work well. The probier wiki is almost entirely single-editor template-overwrite + proxy-link experimentation (A2/OBFUSCATED/C1) with blank labels. Gaps: no code for revert/rollback (distinct from overwrite/remove), for pure ID-churn resaves, for capacity probes, or for format-variant tuning. The A1/A2 boundary breaks on viewer services (jsonhero). The biggest coding hazard is edit summaries containing 'test'—they tempt C1 even on substantive saves; the codebook should rule explicitly that only visible saved content counts. Rendering: URL-run summarization was adequate for A1/A2/A3/OBFUSCATED detection, but collapsing routes to 'via-host -> ?' occasionally hid the ultimate target, and truncation of REMOVED blocks sometimes obscured whether an overwrite restored vs replaced (relevant to the proposed REVERT code). Mojibake lines on RecentChanges/ForumSeite made it unclear whether an agent authored or merely resaved.
